summary: Fall River County Forest Service lookout above Minnekahta; register dates it 1943 (other sources say 1940 or 1941); removed in the 1970s and listed as gone.

facts.status_note: Removed in the 1970s per the FFLOS register; the statewide list shows it gone.

access.note: No source found says whether the site is open to visitors.

corrections.why: Register's Removed field reads 1970s, not a single year; the brief's 1970 is an approximation.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and the July 1943 newspaper item give 1943. firelookout.com gives 1940, a November 1940 item mentions a new station at Parker Mountain, and a 2013 SummitPost caption gives 1941. Story leads with 1943 and reports the others.
Only firelookout.com gives a height ('20' treated timber'); height_m 6.1 converts that figure and no other source confirms it.

notes_for_editor: Built year is disputed (1940, 1941, 1943); story leads with the register's 1943. The 20-foot height is from firelookout.com alone. The SummitPost caption is a 2013 user photo caption; its 'ill-fated' wording is not explained, so the story quotes it without repeating a cause. Two searches found no description of the site today and no access information.
